# 2.56 Corrections, adjustments and scorekeepers (builders' note, parts 1 and 2, 2026-11-23)

Brief check: for a league's admin after a game, on a phone. Done means they reopen a final game with a reason and end it again (public "Corrected" only when the result changed), add or take off an adjustment with its reason that shows in the table, and assign scorekeepers to games; every change in the activity log.
Stock-take (part 1): EXISTED reopen/finalize again (logged), add/removeAdjustment (logged), assign/unassignScorekeeper commands. Nothing listed a game's assigned scorekeepers or who may be assigned.

Messages `en/admin-standings.ts`; notice screen `standings`.

## When a game reads "Corrected" (S-81, decided for you)

- Same score and kind of result after a reopen: no mark. Still open: "Being corrected" (S-47). Different score, or final↔forfeit: marked, dated in the league's time zone by the latest reopen that changed it. Every reopen stays in the log.
